# SYNTARO — Solving Tickets As A Service — Full Documentation

## Overview

SYNTARO is an open-source GitHub bot that automatically fixes labeled issues. Label an issue with `syntaro:fix`, and SYNTARO investigates your codebase, writes a fix, runs your tests, and opens a draft PR. Backed by OpenCode (162K ★ open-source coding agent).

Repository: https://github.com/Aimino-Tech/solving_tickets_as_a_service
License: MIT
Language: TypeScript

## How It Works

1. Install the GitHub App on your repository
2. Label any issue with `syntaro:fix`
3. SYNTARO webhook receives the event and posts a "working on it" comment
4. SYNTARO clones your repo into an isolated Docker sandbox
5. Agent investigates root cause using code analysis and file search
6. Agent implements the fix and writes a regression test
7. Agent runs the existing test suite to verify no regressions
8. Agent commits changes to a branch and pushes
9. SYNTARO creates a draft PR with the fix
10. Quality gates run and results are appended to the PR body

## Installation Paths

### GitHub Action (30 seconds)
```yaml
# .github/workflows/syntaro-fix.yml
name: SYNTARO Fix
on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]
jobs:
  fix:
    if: github.event.label.name == 'syntaro:fix'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: aimino/syntaro-fix-action@v1
        with:
          opencode-endpoint: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_ENDPOINT }}
```

### Self-Hosted (5 minutes)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Aimino-Tech/solving_tickets_as_a_service
cd solving_tickets_as_a_service
npm install
opencode serve --port 4096
cp .env.example .env  # fill in GITHUB_APP_ID, GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY, GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
npm run dev
```

### Docker
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Aimino-Tech/solving_tickets_as_a_service
cd solving_tickets_as_a_service
cp .env.example .env  # fill in env vars
docker compose up -d
```

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `GITHUB_APP_ID` | — | GitHub App ID |
| `GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY` | — | App private key (PEM) |
| `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | — | Webhook secret |
| `OPENCODE_URL` | `http://localhost:4096` | OpenCode serve endpoint |
| `OPENCODE_MODEL` | `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514` | Model to use |
| `SYNTARO_LABEL` | `syntaro:fix` | Issue label to trigger on |
| `SYNTARO_MAX_CONCURRENT` | `3` | Max concurrent fix runs |
| `SYNTARO_PORT` | `3000` | Webhook server port |

## Security

### PromptSanitizer
All user-controlled content (issue body, comments) is sanitized for injection patterns before being passed to the agent. Strips: instruction overrides, role hijacking, system prompt manipulation, data exfiltration attempts, and more.

### GitGuard
Blocks destructive git operations in agent sandboxes:
- Blocked: `push --force`, `branch -D`, `reset --hard`, `rebase --force`, `gc --prune`, `clean -fd`, `checkout -- .`, `filter-branch`
- Allowed: `add`, `commit`, `push` (safe), `checkout -b`, `log`, `diff`, `status`, `config`, `clone`

### Sandbox Isolation
- Docker containers with resource limits (memory, CPU)
- Network restrictions via egress proxy (Squid)
- Ephemeral — destroyed after fix generation
- No persistent storage

### GitHub Permissions (Minimum Required)
- `contents: write` — create PRs and branches
- `issues: read` — read labeled issues
- `pull_requests: write` — create PRs

## Quality Gates

Every fix passes through 6 quality gates before PR creation:

1. **Reality Check** — Every referenced file actually exists
2. **Compile Check** — TypeScript compiler passes (tsc --noEmit)
3. **Test Integrity** — Tests have real assertions (no vacuous tests)
4. **Hallucination/Stub** — No TODO stubs, placeholders, or fake imports
5. **Dead Code Check** — No orphaned files or unused exports (knip/ts-prune)
6. **External AI Tool Scan** — No hallucinated packages or phantom APIs (ghostcheck/trace-core)

Results are surfaced in a collapsible quality report in every PR body.

## Supported Languages

Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Rust, Ruby, Java, PHP, Swift, Dart, Elixir, C++, .NET — with automatic runtime detection.

## What SYNTARO Can Fix

✅ Single-file bugs, typing errors, logic errors, test failures, linter issues, simple refactors, README/docs fixes

## What SYNTARO Cannot Fix

❌ Multi-file refactors, database migrations, dependency upgrades, configuration changes, feature requests, cross-cutting concerns, security vulnerabilities

## Business Model

Open-core with three tiers:
- **OSS Self-Hosted**: Unlimited fixes, your API key, your infrastructure — $0
- **Cloud Free**: 10 fixes/month — $0
- **Cloud Pro**: 100 fixes/month, SLA — $49/mo
